prompts.paperAvatarPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original EmCoin player avatar and role icon design sheet. Square, carefully art-directed character library on warm paper-yellow #EDE4CF. EXACTLY 12 human head-and-shoulder avatar portraits in a clean uniform 4 column by 3 row grid, each centered, same visual scale, no frames, ample spacing. Important style: SIMPLE editorial CUT-PAPER collage, bold rounded cutout shapes and restrained paper grain, flat 2D silhouettes, tiny navy oval/dot eyes, one small mouth curve, a few simple asymmetrical hair shapes. NOT anime, NOT realistic, NOT Disney/Pixar/3D, NOT emoji stock art, no detailed hair strands, no gloss, no baby faces. Youthful Vietnamese/Asian teens with some varied skin tones, varied genders, short hair, bob, curls, ponytail, braid, two with simple round glasses. Warm approachable personalities, differences visible at 40px. Palette: denim #205777, ink #123e59, coral #df7465, muted ochre #e6b457, paper ivory, natural brown/black hair and skin tones. Beneath portraits draw a tidy row of SEVEN ORIGINAL role icons using the SAME cut-paper navy/coral shapes: facilitator speech bubble, storytelling heart envelope, healing hand supporting sprout, silence closed padlock, connection linked loops, invitation opening present, guidance compass. Prioritize recognizable silhouette and low detail. No text, labels, numbers, watermark, vendor characters or imitation of any existing stock asset pack.
prompts.orbitSimplePrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Input image is our newly generated original Paper Friends design sheet, not a third-party asset. Make the Emotion Orbit counterpart. KEEP the same 12 original character identities, hair silhouettes, facial dot/oval eyes, mouth curves, body framing and the same 4x3 portrait grid plus seven bottom role icons. Change only illustration material and palette: remove cut-paper grain and use clean matte 2D vector-like shapes with subtle soft satin edge shading, lavender-white background #f5f3ff, navy-indigo #303568, lavender #b4ade6, dusty pink #c96487, ivory clothing, natural skin and dark hair. Absolutely preserve the simple low-detail friendly editorial faces, not anime, not realistic, no hair strands, no 3D gloss. Simplify any excessive paper edge roughness into softly rounded hand-drawn edges. Role icons retain speech circle, heart envelope, healing sprout hand, closed lock, linked loops, gift, compass but recolored indigo/lavender/berry. No labels, text, numbers, watermark, extra characters or frames. Intended for avatars readable at 40px in an emotional learning game.
prompts.paperAnimalsPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original EmCoin Paper Friends animal avatar atlas matching the simple human paper-cut avatar library. Palette denim #205777, coral #df7465, muted ochre, paper ivory, natural browns. Plain paper-yellow #EDE4CF background. A square sheet with EXACTLY three evenly spaced rows and four columns. No humans, props, text, labels, frames, watermark or shadows.
